name: working-text
description: Working text that scans well and names real code: the device picked from the content, a paragraph-cap and path probe, fact-preserving restructures, and the architecture page whose boxes name real symbols.

interface.shortDescription: Working text that scans well and names real code.
interface.longDescription: Fires when working text is written or reviewed: anything a colleague scans to get work done, from a README or a comment to a PR or a diagram. Each fact is shown by the device that shows it fastest, paragraphs stay under 70 words, and a probe measures the cap and checks every named path. The architecture page adds a layering lint, a module map, and a page test.
defaultPrompt: This guide is a wall of text; reshape it without losing a fact.
Run the docs probe over docs/ and fix what it names.
Add an architecture page with a module map for this repository.
